animations.name: button-transition
animations.css: transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, opacity, box-shadow, transform, filter, backdrop-filter; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); transition-duration: 150ms;
animations.description: Standard button state transition applied to all interactive buttons for smooth hover and active state changes.

animations.name: tab-indicator-transition
animations.description: Opacity transition for tab selection indicator backgrounds.

animations.name: carousel-slide
animations.description: JS-driven carousel animation for voice cards. Cards scale and translate with easing (360ms transition-duration, ease timing function) as they move between positions. Includes opacity transitions for edge items.

animations.name: card-hover-scale
animations.description: Hover scale effect on voice cards with border ring appearing. Scale transitions from 0.985 to 1 with opacity change.

animations.name: active-scale
animations.description: Active/pressed state scale transformation for buttons, providing tactile feedback on click.

animations.name: sticky-header-slide
animations.css: transition-property: transform, visibility; transition-duration: 300ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
animations.description: Sticky contextual navigation bar slides in from top with transform translateY and visibility transitions.

animations.name: color-transition
animations.css: transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); transition-duration: 150ms;
animations.description: Standard color transition for text and background color changes on interactive elements.

insights: The design system uses a pill-shaped (rounded-full) button paradigm consistently across all interactive elements, from CTAs to tabs to icon buttons, creating strong visual cohesion.

A sophisticated tab system with three distinct states (selected, default, hover) uses white backgrounds with subtle shadows for selection, avoiding harsh borders in favor of elevation for state indication.
The carousel component employs JS-driven animations with progressive scaling and opacity changes to create depth perception, making adjacent items appear to recede into the background.
